name: keybars-streamdeck
description: keybars Pro on a Stream Deck: Focus, the lights, what the keyboard plays, and events from a key.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=app.keybars.streamdeck.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack app.keybars.streamdeck.sdPlugin --force -o dist
